newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's CorpGro switches JSE sector.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's CorpGro switches JSE sector.

text.p: South Africa's CorpGro Ltd said on Wednesday the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) had agreed to switch its listing from the "Industrial-Stores" sector to the "Industrial-Holdings" sector effective immediately.

"The directors of CorpGro are of the opinion that the Industrial Holdings sector reflects more accurately the vision, strategy and nature of activities of the CorpGro group of companies," the firm said in a statement.
